title: NASA releases picture of Earthset shot by Artemis crew
summary: NASA on Tuesday released a historic image of Earth dipping below the lunar horizon, a so-called "Earthset", more than 57 years after an iconic "Earthrise" image was captured by an Apollo 8 astronaut during the first human flyby of the Moon. Members of the Artemis II crew captured the image on Monday during the mission's record-setting lunar flyby.
